# Measurements

<!-- Generated by `python -m alpamayo1_5.trace.measurements_doc > docs/MEASUREMENTS.md`. Do not edit by hand: tests/test_measurements_doc.py fails until this file matches the code. -->

What a run measures, where each number lands, and what it means. Rendered from `src/alpamayo1_5/trace/timing_schema.py` and the writer, so it is as current as the code.

Raw measurements go to parquet and on to Hugging Face; MLflow gets run-level aggregates and params only. Anything that can be computed from the parquet is not stored twice.

## Files

| file | one row per | goes to | version |
|---|---|---|---|
| `predictions.parquet` | sample | HF | schema 3, frozen |
| `per_clip.parquet` | clip | HF | schema 3, frozen |
| `timing.parquet` | pass | HF | timing schema 13 |
| `thermal.parquet` | board reading | HF | thermal schema 1 |
| `layers.parquet` | layer span of a main pass (`--trace-level layer`) | HF | layers schema 2 |
| `kernels.parquet` | device event of a profile pass (`--profile-clips`) | HF | kernels schema 1 |
| `run.json` | run | MLflow artifact and HF | the run's config, params, work model, probe peaks, calibration |
| `memsnap_*.pickle, profile_*.json.gz` | -- | local only | paths in run.json |

## Passes

Every inference is a row of `timing.parquet`, told apart by `row_kind`.

| row_kind | made by |  |
|---|---|---|
| `main` | -- | The clip's pass. The only rows latency means and `predictions.parquet` use. |
| `warmup` | `--warmup N` | Before the first clip, on it. Recorded, never averaged. |
| `probe` | `--overhead-probe N` | The first N clips again at level off and at the run's level, order alternating: `trace.overhead_pct`. |
| `repeat` | `--timing-repeats R` | The same clip again: `latency_cv`, `cold_start_ms`. |
| `memsnap` | `--memory-snapshot N` | Under the allocator's history recorder. |
| `flops` | `--flop-count N` | FLOPs and bytes counted by segment. Never timed. |
| `profile` | `--profile-clips N` | Under torch.profiler, at level basic. Never timed. |

## Trace levels

Recorded on every row as `trace_level`. Latency is never compared across levels.

| level |  |
|---|---|
| `off` | No hook. The wall clock only: the probe's baseline. |
| `basic` | Segment spans, per-call arrays, token statistics. The default. |
| `step` | Also inside the steps: projections, KV concatenation, processors, stopping, and a sync audit. About 150 marks a decode step. |
| `layer` | Also every layer of all three stacks: the attention -- its Q/K/V and output projections and its cache update apart -- and the MLP: `layers.parquet`. 648 marks a language-model or head call. |

## Settings

Set in `scripts/run.sh` (or `OVERRIDE_<NAME>=... ./scripts/run.sh`).

| run.sh | flag |  |
|---|---|---|
| `TRACE_LEVEL` | `--trace-level` | How deep the instrumentation goes (above). |
| `WARMUP` | `--warmup` | Untimed passes before the first clip (default 2). |
| `OVERHEAD_PROBE` | `--overhead-probe` | Clips that get the off/on probe pair (default 4). |
| `TIMING_REPEATS` | `--timing-repeats` | Repeat passes per clip on the first REPEAT_CLIPS. |
| `REPEAT_CLIPS` | `--repeat-clips` | How many clips get the repeats. |
| `MEMORY_SNAPSHOT` | `--memory-snapshot` | Clips that get an allocator-history pass. |
| `SAMPLE_HZ` | `--sample-hz` | Board sampler rate (default 10). |
| `CUDA_GRAPH` | `--cuda-graph` | Replay the expert through CUDA graphs. |
| `CUDA_GRAPH_MAX_GRAPHS` | `--cuda-graph-max-graphs` | Captured signatures kept. |
| `PROFILE_CLIPS` | `--profile-clips` | Clips that get a torch.profiler pass. |
| `PROFILE_TRACE` | `--profile-trace` | Keep those passes' Chrome traces (local). |
| `FLOP_COUNT` | `--flop-count` | Clips that get a counted pass. |
| `ROOFLINE_PROBE` | `--roofline-probe` | Measure the board's peaks before the first clip. |
| `DEADLINE_MS` | `--deadline-ms` | A latency budget to report misses against. |
| `STEADY_SKIP` | `--steady-skip` | Clips left out of the steady-state numbers. |
| `MODEL_REVISION` | `--model-revision` | The model snapshot loaded and recorded. |

## timing.parquet (schema 13, tracer 5)

`better` is what a comparison calls an improvement; blank for counts and conditions, where ranking would be a mistake. `since` is the schema version that added the column.

### identity

Which run, clip and pass the row is.

| column | type | unit | better | since |  |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `timing_schema_version` | int16 |  |  | 1 | Version of this table's column set. |
| `tracer_version` | int16 |  |  | 1 | Version of the basic-level instrumentation. Latency is compared only within one. |
| `run_id` | string |  |  | 1 | MLflow run id, or a local id when the run was not tracked. |
| `variant` | string |  |  | 1 | The run's comparison label. |
| `git_commit` | string |  |  | 1 | Commit of the code that produced the row. |
| `clip_id` | string |  |  | 1 | Clip the pass ran on. |
| `t0_us` | int64 | us |  | 1 | Sample timestamp within the clip. |
| `clip_index` | int32 |  |  | 1 | Position of the clip in the run's clip list. |
| `row_kind` | string |  |  | 1 | main \| warmup \| probe \| repeat \| memsnap \| flops \| profile. Only main rows feed predictions and latency aggregates. |
| `pass_index` | int16 |  |  | 1 | 0 for a clip's main pass; extra passes over the same clip count up from 1. |
| `t_start_unix_s` | float64 | s |  | 1 | Wall-clock time the pass started, Unix seconds. |
| `t_start_host_s` | float64 | s |  | 1 | perf_counter when the pass started. The board sampler stamps the same clock, which is what lets its readings be attributed to a pass. |

### condition

What the pass was measured under, repeated on every row so runs concatenate. Latency is compared only between rows that agree on these (`compare.TIMING_PAIRING`).

| column | type | unit | better | since |  |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `machine` | string |  |  | 1 | Where the run happened. Latency never crosses machines. |
| `power_mode` | string |  |  | 1 | nvpmodel mode name. |
| `torch_version` | string |  |  | 1 | torch build; its kernels are part of the measurement. |
| `transformers_version` | string |  |  | 1 | transformers version; it owns the decode loop. |
| `cuda_runtime` | string |  |  | 1 | CUDA runtime torch was built against. |
| `attn_impl` | string |  |  | 1 | Attention implementation requested at load. |
| `dtype` | string |  |  | 1 | Compute dtype. |
| `model` | string |  |  | 1 | Model coordinate as given on the command line. |
| `data_spec` | string |  |  | 1 | Camera and sensor configuration. |
| `num_traj_samples` | int16 |  |  | 1 | K, trajectories per clip. |
| `inference_step` | int16 |  |  | 1 | Euler steps requested; null means the default. |
| `max_new_tokens` | int16 |  |  | 1 | Generation cap actually passed to generate. |
| `cuda_graph` | bool |  |  | 1 | Whether the expert was replayed through CUDA graphs. |
| `cuda_graph_max_graphs` | int16 |  |  | 1 | Captured signatures kept; null when graphs are off. |
| `trace_level` | string |  |  | 1 | How deep the instrumentation went. Deeper levels cost more; never compare latency across levels. |
| `sample_hz` | float32 | Hz |  | 1 | Board sampler rate while the pass ran. |
| `warmup` | int16 |  |  | 1 | Untimed inferences run before the first main pass. |
| `overhead_probe` | int16 |  |  | 4 | Clips that got an extra off/on pass pair to measure the tracer's own cost. |
| `timing_repeats` | int16 |  |  | 4 | Extra passes per repeated clip, for the noise band. |
| `repeat_clips` | int16 |  |  | 4 | How many clips, from the start, got the repeats. |
| `pass_output_match` | bool |  |  | 4 | Extra passes only: whether the trajectories came out bit-identical to the main pass. False means the passes were not replicates, and their timing differences are not noise. |
| `l4t_release` | string |  |  | 7 | Jetson Linux release. A JetPack upgrade changes kernels, clocks and power policy. |
| `nvidia_driver` | string |  |  | 7 | GPU driver version. |

### segment

The legacy split, on the device clock, with the definitions `predictions.parquet` has carried since schema 1.

| column | type | unit | better | since |  |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `t_vision_ms` | float64 | ms | lower | 1 | Vision tower span, device clock. |
| `t_prefill_ms` | float64 | ms | lower | 1 | First language-model call, device clock. |
| `t_decode_ms` | float64 | ms | lower | 1 | Every later language-model call, device clock. |
| `t_postgen_ms` | float64 | ms | lower | 1 | From generate returning to the trajectory head starting. Host work lives here. |
| `t_expert_ms` | float64 | ms | lower | 1 | The diffusion sampler, all Euler steps. |
| `t_other_ms` | float64 | ms | lower | 1 | The generate span minus vision, prefill and decode: lm_head, logits processing, sampling, stopping criteria. |
| `t_total_ms` | float64 | ms | lower | 1 | Generate span + postgen + expert. |
| `n_vision_calls` | int16 |  |  | 1 | Vision tower calls in the pass. |
| `n_decode_steps` | int16 |  |  | 1 | Language-model calls after prefill -- decode's denominator, since the batch decodes until its last row finishes. |
| `n_expert_calls` | int16 |  |  | 1 | Euler steps that actually executed. |
| `timing_measured` | bool |  |  | 1 | False: every time in the row is absent, not zero. |

### clock

Both clocks around the pass: CUDA events for the device, `perf_counter` for the host.

| column | type | unit | better | since |  |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `t_wall_ms` | float64 | ms | lower | 1 | Host wall clock from tracer install to after the final synchronize: what the caller waited. The device spans cannot see host gaps between them; this can. |
| `t_compute_span_ms` | float64 | ms |  | 1 | Device time inside the vision, prefill, decode and expert spans. Idle inside a span is included, so this is not GPU busy time -- that comes from the kernel profile. |

### per_call

Every decode step and Euler step, on both clocks.

| column | type | unit | better | since |  |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `vision_call_ms` | list<float32> | ms | lower | 1 | Each vision tower call, device clock. |
| `decode_step_ms` | list<float32> | ms | lower | 1 | Each decode step, device clock. |
| `decode_step_host_ms` | list<float32> | ms |  | 1 | Each decode step, host clock: how long Python took to enqueue it. |
| `expert_step_ms` | list<float32> | ms | lower | 1 | Each Euler step of the trajectory head, device clock. The first carries warmup and, with graphs on, the capture. |
| `expert_step_host_ms` | list<float32> | ms |  | 1 | Each Euler step, host clock. |

### alloc

The CUDA caching allocator over the pass.

| column | type | unit | better | since |  |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `n_cuda_allocs` | int64 |  | lower | 1 | Allocator allocations during the pass. A KV cache rebuilt by concatenation on every layer and step lands here in the hundreds. |
| `n_alloc_retries` | int64 |  | lower | 1 | Allocator retries: each is a cache flush and a stall in whichever span was unlucky. |

### graph

The expert's CUDA graph runner, when one is installed.

| column | type | unit | better | since |  |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `graph_captures` | int32 |  |  | 1 | Expert CUDA graphs captured; null when graphs are off. |
| `graph_replays` | int32 |  |  | 1 | Expert steps replayed. A capture step also counts as a replay. |
| `graph_fallbacks` | int32 |  | lower | 1 | Expert steps that ran eager with a graph runner installed. Never average latency over rows that fell back together with rows that did not. |
| `graph_n_graphs` | int32 |  |  | 1 | Graphs held by the runner after the pass. |
| `graph_capture_ms` | float64 | ms | lower | 1 | Host time spent capturing during the pass. |
| `graph_mode` | string |  |  | 1 | none \| replay \| capture \| fallback \| mixed: which path the pass's expert steps took. |

### trace

What the tracer itself cost: its marks, its hooks' host time, its logits pass.

| column | type | unit | better | since |  |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `t_trace_consume_ms` | float64 | ms | lower | 2 | Device time of the tracer's own logits pass. It runs inside the postgen window, so t_postgen_ms includes it -- kept there so the legacy column keeps its meaning. |
| `t_trace_consume_host_ms` | float64 | ms | lower | 2 | The same pass, host clock. |
| `t_postgen_model_ms` | float64 | ms | lower | 2 | postgen minus the tracer's logits pass: what the model's own code between generate and the trajectory head cost. |
| `trace_n_marks` | int32 |  |  | 2 | Marks recorded in the pass. |
| `trace_hook_host_ms` | float64 | ms | lower | 2 | Host time spent inside the tracer's marks. The instrument's own cost, per pass. |

### generate

`generate` split into its preamble, lm_head, forward glue and loop; the first token.

| column | type | unit | better | since |  |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `t_gen_preamble_ms` | float64 | ms | lower | 3 | generate's start to the first forward: K-fold input expansion, cache and processor setup. |
| `t_lm_head_ms` | float64 | ms | lower | 3 | The vocabulary projection, every step. It runs after the language model returns, so the decode span never included it -- 1.27 GB of weights read per step. |
| `t_vlm_glue_ms` | float64 | ms | lower | 3 | Inside each VLM forward but outside vision, the language model and lm_head: embeddings, image-token scatter, rope index, deepstack. |
| `t_gen_loop_ms` | float64 | ms | lower | 3 | generate outside every forward: logits processors, sampling, stopping criteria and the host syncs between steps. |
| `t_ttft_ms` | float64 | ms | lower | 3 | Host clock from the model call to the second forward -- the first reasoning token is on the host by then, since the loop syncs on it. |
| `n_vlm_forwards` | int16 |  |  | 3 | VLM forward calls: prefill plus decode steps. |
| `lm_head_step_ms` | list<float32> | ms | lower | 3 | Each lm_head call, device clock. |
| `decode_gap_ms` | list<float32> | ms | lower | 3 | Device time between consecutive forwards: the host loop each decode step waits on. |
| `trace_span_violations` | int16 |  | lower | 3 | Derived spans that came out negative and were floored. Nonzero means a nesting assumption broke and the split is suspect. |

## Long tables

One row per reading, span or device event; each joins its timing row on `(clip_id, row_kind, pass_index)`. Profile segments are `pre`, `vision`, `prefill`, `decode`, `lm_head`, `gen_other`, `postgen`, `trace`, `expert`, `head_other`, `tail`; kernel categories `attention`, `gemm`, `conv`, `cat`, `copy`, `norm`, `softmax`, `reduction`, `elementwise`, `memory`, `other`.

### thermal.parquet

| column | type |  |
|---|---|---|
| `thermal_schema_version` | int16 | This table's version. |
| `run_id` | string | The run. |
| `tick` | int32 | The sampler's tick; the slow sensors read on every fifth, at most. |
| `t_host_s` | float64 | perf_counter at the reading -- the clock the tracer's host marks use. |
| `t_unix_s` | float64 | Wall-clock time at the reading. |
| `read_ms` | float32 | What the tick's reads took. |
| `clip_index` | int32 | The clip running then; null between clips. |
| `phase` | string | What the runner was doing: idle, warmup, load, infer, post, extra, between. |
| `sensor` | string | Which reading: power.<rail>, freq.gpu, freq.emc, freq.cpu_<policy>, oc.oc<n>, cool.<device>, fan.*, util.gpu, and the thermal zones. |
| `value` | float64 | The reading. |
| `unit` | string | Its unit. |

### layers.parquet

| column | type |  |
|---|---|---|
| `layers_schema_version` | int16 | This table's version. |
| `run_id` | string | The run. |
| `clip_id` | string | The clip. |
| `clip_index` | int32 | Its position in the run. |
| `row_kind` | string | The pass's kind, as in timing.parquet. |
| `pass_index` | int16 | The pass's index on the clip, as in timing.parquet. |
| `timing_schema_version` | int16 | timing.parquet's version when this was written. |
| `tracer_version` | int16 | The tracer's version when this was written. |
| `stack` | string | vision, lm or expert. |
| `phase` | string | vision, prefill, decode or expert: the language model's call 0 is the prefill. |
| `call_index` | int16 | The stack's n-th call in the pass: a decode or Euler step. |
| `layer` | int16 | The layer's index in its stack. |
| `part` | string | attn, mlp, or block -- the whole layer, so block - attn - mlp is its norms and residuals; inside the attention q_proj, k_proj and v_proj (qkv, fused, in the vision tower), o_proj, and kv_cat, the cache update (layers schema 2). |
| `device_ms` | float32 | The span on the device clock. |
| `host_ms` | float32 | The span on the host clock. |

### kernels.parquet

| column | type |  |
|---|---|---|
| `kernels_schema_version` | int16 | This table's version. |
| `run_id` | string | The run. |
| `clip_id` | string | The clip. |
| `clip_index` | int32 | Its position in the run. |
| `row_kind` | string | The pass's kind, as in timing.parquet. |
| `pass_index` | int16 | The pass's index on the clip, as in timing.parquet. |
| `timing_schema_version` | int16 | timing.parquet's version when this was written. |
| `tracer_version` | int16 | The tracer's version when this was written. |
| `kind` | string | kernel, memcpy or memset. |
| `segment` | string | The host segment whose code launched it (profile_parse.SEGMENTS). |
| `step_index` | int16 | The decode, Euler or vision call it was launched in; null elsewhere. |
| `name` | string | The kernel's name. |
| `op` | string | The innermost op that launched it; null for none. |
| `category` | string | What it did (profile_parse.CATEGORIES): from the op, SDPA first, else from the name. |
| `stream` | int32 | The CUDA stream. |
| `start_us` | float64 | Its start, microseconds from the call's start. |
| `dur_us` | float32 | Its duration. |
| `launch_us` | float32 | Its launch call's duration on the host, blocking included. |
| `lead_us` | float32 | From the launch call's return to its start. Near zero, the device was waiting on the host. |
| `grid_size` | int64 | Blocks in the grid. |
| `block_size` | int32 | Threads per block. |
| `regs_per_thread` | int16 | Registers per thread. |
| `smem_bytes` | int32 | Shared memory per block. |

## MLflow metrics

Logged once, in one batch, at the end of the run: aggregates over the main passes, and the extra passes' own numbers (probe, profile, counted). The efficiency numbers need run.json's `work_model`; the roof fractions also need `--roofline-probe`. A FLOP calibration outside [0.9, 1.1] is reported as a wrong formula.

- headline (no prefix): `t_vision_ms`, `t_prefill_ms`, `t_decode_ms`, `t_postgen_ms`, `t_expert_ms`, `t_other_ms`, `t_total_ms`, `t_total_ms_p50`, `t_total_ms_p95`, `t_total_ms_p99`, `latency_p95`, `t_wall_ms`, `t_wall_ms_p50`, `t_wall_ms_p95`, `t_wall_ms_p99`, `compute_span_ratio`, `expert_step_first_ms`, `expert_step_steady_ms`, `expert_step_p95_ms`, `expert_step_spread_ms`, `expert_launch_ratio`, `decode_step_p95_ms`, `decode_launch_ratio`, `t_postgen_model_ms`, `t_gen_preamble_ms`, `t_lm_head_ms`, `t_vlm_glue_ms`, `t_gen_loop_ms`, `t_ttft_ms`, `t_ttft_ms_p95`, `decode_gap_ms`, `decode_gap_ms_p95`, `lm_head_step_ms`, `cold_start_ms`, `cold_start_excess_ms`, `latency_cv`, `latency_cv_n`, `t_pre_generate_ms`, `t_tail_ms`, `t_action_to_traj_ms`, `t_first_traj_ms`, `t_first_traj_ms_p95`, `t_total_ms_std`, `t_total_ms_iqr`, `t_total_ms_max`, `t_wall_ms_std`, `t_wall_ms_iqr`, `t_wall_ms_max`, `t_first_traj_ms_max`

## Changelog

| timing schema |  |
|---|---|
| 1 | Initial table: legacy spans, host wall clock, per-call arrays, allocator and CUDA-graph counters, run conditions. |
| 2 | The tracer's own cost: t_trace_consume_ms and its host twin, t_postgen_model_ms, trace_n_marks, trace_hook_host_ms. Tracer 2 marks its logits pass. |
| 3 | generate split: t_gen_preamble_ms, t_lm_head_ms, t_vlm_glue_ms, t_gen_loop_ms, t_ttft_ms, n_vlm_forwards, lm_head_step_ms, decode_gap_ms, trace_span_violations. Tracer 3 hooks the VLM forward and lm_head. |
| 4 | Measurement protocol: overhead_probe, timing_repeats and repeat_clips conditions, pass_output_match. Warmup, probe and repeat passes are rows of their own kind. |
| 5 | Host side: the clip's stages outside the call (data, tokenization, copies, metrics, figures), the spans before generate and after the head, first trajectory, thread CPU per segment, context switches, RSS. Tracer 4 marks the call and stamps thread CPU. |
| 6 | Memory and shapes: allocator peak per segment, clip peak, reserved peak, OOMs, host memory available; the KV cache the head attends to, the image and patch counts, and the memory_snapshot condition. Tracer 5 reads the allocator at segment boundaries. |
| 7 | Board conditions: l4t_release and nvidia_driver. sample_hz is now the fast tier's rate (10 by default). |
| 8 | Board attribution per pass: energy per rail and per segment, power mean and peaks, coverage, GPU clock per segment, EMC minimum, over-current events, throttle state, junction peak, anchor lag. |
| 9 | Trace level step: per Euler step (projections, KV concatenation, crop, rest), per decode step (logits processors, stopping, input preparation, KV concatenation), KV totals and bytes, postgen and vision parts, synchronizations by phase. |
| 10 | Trace level layer: attention, MLP and whole-layer time per phase, and the span count; the spans themselves go to layers.parquet. |
| 11 | Profile passes: kernels, device time, true GPU idle, launch and sync calls per host segment; device time by category; SDPA backend per phase. Kernels go to kernels.parquet. |
| 12 | Counted passes: FLOPs and operand bytes per host segment, and the ops counted. |
| 13 | Trace level layer: the attention's Q/K/V and output projections and its cache update, per phase. layers.parquet 2 gains the parts q_proj, k_proj, v_proj, qkv, o_proj and kv_cat. |
